name: Clear Application - int_window
intent: Clear topcoat only (brush/spray). Used in decomposed CLEAR phase after sealer has been applied separately. No sealer tasks here — sealer was applied in the SEALER phase.
doctrine: Clear apply for int_window decomposed CLEAR phase. Contains only the clear topcoat tasks — sealer is handled in MOD_APPLY_WINDOW_SEALER (separate SEALER phase scenario). Interstage sanding between clear coats fires via dynamic_coats.interstage = MOD_INTERSTAGE_WINDOW.
